title: The meaning of democracy
competency: Describe where the word democracy comes from, define democracy and explain rule of the people.

keywords.def: A system of government in which ultimate political power is in the hands of the people.
The literal meaning of democracy: the people hold the power.
A person elected to act and decide for others.

ideas.name: Democracy means rule of the people

en.text: Democracy comes from two Greek words. Demos means the people and kratos means to rule. So democracy means rule of the people. The people rule directly, or through representatives they elect.

screens.title: Choosing a leader
screens.ask: Your class must choose a class representative. Which way is the most democratic?
opts: The teacher picks a favourite student
The tallest student becomes the leader
screens.after: When everyone takes part and votes freely, the people decide. That is the idea of democracy.

screens.title: 3.1 The meaning of democracy
paras: The term democracy comes from two Greek words.
Demos means "the people". Kratos means "to rule".
Together, democracy literally means "rule of the people".

screens.title: A system of government
paras: Democracy is a system of government in which people rule.
They rule directly, or indirectly through their elected representatives.
screens.note: REMEMBER: Democracy is a people-centred system. The people are its heart, root and fruit.

screens.title: Build the word
items: A Greek word that means "the people".
A Greek word that means "to rule".

screens.title: Key words
defs: A system of government in which ultimate political power is in the hands of the people.

screens.text: What does the Greek word "demos" mean?
screens.why: Demos means "the people". Kratos means "to rule".
screens.clue: Democracy = demos + kratos. Which part is about who rules?

screens.why: Demos (the people) + kratos (to rule) = rule of the people.
screens.clue: Think of the meaning of demos.

screens.text: In a democracy, people can rule only directly, never through representatives.
screens.why: People rule directly or indirectly through elected representatives.
screens.clue: Read the definition again: directly or …?

screens.text: Which sentence best matches the REMEMBER box: "the people are the heart, root and fruit" of democracy?
opts: Democracy starts from the people, works through them and serves them
Leaders own the power and the people obey
screens.ans: Democracy starts from the people, works through them and serves them
screens.why: Root: power comes from the people. Heart: the people take part. Fruit: the results serve the people.
screens.clue: Think of a tree: where does it start, what keeps it alive, what does it give?

ideas.name: Of the people, by the people, for the people

en.text: Abraham Lincoln called democracy government of the people, by the people and for the people. Of the people: leaders get their power because the people elect them. By the people: the people take part and govern themselves. For the people: leaders must act in the people's best interest.

screens.title: Something is missing
screens.ask: A government is elected by the people but only works for the leaders' families. What is missing?
screens.after: A democratic government must also act in the best interest of the people. That is "for the people".

screens.title: Lincoln's definition
paras: Abraham Lincoln, a former US president, defined democracy as "government of the people, by the people, and for the people".
table: Officials are elected by the people. This is the source of legitimacy.
The public takes part in government: popular self-government.
Officials act in the best interests of the people.

screens.title: Key words
defs: A person elected to act and decide for others.

pairs: Leaders get power by being elected
People take part and govern themselves
Leaders act in the people's best interest
screens.why: Each phrase answers a different question: where power comes from, who takes part, and whom it serves.
screens.clue: Of = source, by = who does it, for = who benefits.

screens.text: "Government by the people" is also called:
screens.why: Public participation and self-government is called popular self-government.
screens.clue: Who does the governing in "by the people"?

screens.text: Lincoln said "government of the people" means officials get their legitimacy from being elected by the people.
screens.why: Of the people represents the source of legitimacy: officials are elected by the people.
screens.clue: Look at the first row of the table.

screens.text: The kebele council builds a clinic after asking residents what they need most. Which part of Lincoln's definition does this show best?
screens.why: The council acts in the best interest of the residents. That is government for the people.

items.text: 35 students nominate classmates and freely elect a male and a female representative. What does this case show?
opts: Democracy: the people choose who leads them
items.ans: Democracy: the people choose who leads them
items.why: All students took part in a free and fair election. The leaders get their power from the voters.

items.text: Why does the class need two representatives?
opts: If one is absent, the other (vice) takes the role
Two people are always better at sports
items.ans: If one is absent, the other (vice) takes the role
items.why: The book says the second (vice) representative replaces the first when needed.
items.clue: Read why the case study wants two.

items.text: Some say democracy is not built overnight. Why?
opts: Democratization is a process that takes time and many actors
Democracy is built in one election day
items.ans: Democratization is a process that takes time and many actors
items.why: Building democracy takes time. Parties, media, public opinion and civil society must work together.
items.clue: Is democracy an event or a process?

test.text: In democracy, people may rule through elected representatives.
test.why: People rule directly or indirectly through representatives.

opts: Officials act in the people's best interest
test.ans: Officials act in the people's best interest

test.text: A leader is freely elected, but then ignores what the people need. Which part of Lincoln's definition is he failing?
test.why: He was elected (of the people) but does not act in their interest.
